counting_policy: one event candidate per canonical source segment and date; translations do not add events

evidence.en: Um piloto comercial relatou ter visto um objeto em forma de disco voador a uma altitude de 3.000 metros, movendo-se a uma velocidade de 240 km/h, em 15 de junho de 1951, sobre o estado de São Paulo, Brasil. O objeto era de cor prateada e tinha um brilho intenso. O piloto descreveu-o como um "disco voador" e estimou que ele tinha um diâmetro de 15 a 20 metros. O objeto se movia em um ângulo de 45 graus em relação ao solo e, em seguida, desapareceu repentinamente. O piloto não conseguiu identifica

10/14/68 — 3rd floor, apartment 12/10/68: between Sabin and Guarapiranga — UFO observed from a distance of approximately 5 points; 32 appearances: between Sabin and Guarapiranga while the reporter and family members were present. During one of these appearances, after the object flew away, it was witnessed by Luzia, who was called as a witness. The observer saw the UFO approach when he encountered people who were also observing the phenomenon. He stopped his car and felt a strong emotion.

The observer saw the UFO approach when he encountered people who were also observing the phenomenon. He stopped his car and felt a strong emotion.
